description: Channels-owned normalization slice stacked on .14.1. Extend existing communication bridge/provider adapters and normalized Incoming facts for trusted connector/channel/thread identity and per-message recipient evidence. For email: sender copy, visible To/Cc, hidden Bcc only via independently identified receiving account or confirmed outbound envelope, not IMAP folder/Delivered-To/thread-participant guesses; no retroactive association. Reject ambiguous/mismatched accounts and unsupported mapping; preserve current mention gating and legacy ingress. Tests FIRST at adapters/bridge with actual parser fixtures and property tests for recipient deduplication and fail-closed evidence. Reuse existing Channels connector resolution/normalizers, not parallel Action/tool; NodeRouter for cross-service calls. Read Engine/Channels and system-config if touching secrets, docs/action-reuse.md/testing-approach.md; update Channels guide. No new-feature E2E before human UX approval.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 children .14.2.1 shipped as draft PR #813 on #812; .14.2.2 email evidence and .14.2.3 Jido Chat room-type evidence remain open. Email discovery before implementation: ImapAdapter.Parser currently extracts only first To and reply_from (possibly Delivered-To); IMAP mailbox field is folder, not receiving address. EmailBridge.send_reply uses SmtpSender.send_notification(identifier,payload,..) which returns only :ok/error and derives actual sender via payload/settings. Do not infer sender or Bcc from reply thread, Delivered-To, IMAP folder, or configured notification default. To fulfill sender copy and confirmed outbound-envelope Bcc, a receipt must carry the actual sender/envelope recipient without duplicating SmtpSender delivery; preserve legacy return compatibility or extend receipt at owning boundary. Channels normalizes address evidence, Engine .4 resolves Person identities/authorizes targets; no raw Bcc in shared projection. #807/#808/#811 CI green, #812/#813 pending E2E; no new-feature E2E authored.
